benefits_health_001.evidence: Group health insurance coverage is provided through TRS-ActiveCare, the statewide public school employee health insurance program. Employees eligible for health insurance coverage include the following: • Employees who are active, contributing TRS members • Employees who are not contributing TRS members and who are regularly scheduled to work at least 10 hours per week

benefits_dental_006.evidence: At their own expense, employees may enroll in supplemental insurance programs for Dental, eye and Cancer.
